daily_quests.title: ASX 200 Price Momentum Analysis with Window Functions
daily_quests.description: Using the ASX 200 historical prices dataset, calculate a 20-day moving average and identify the top 5 stocks by momentum (price change %) over the last 30 days. Use window functions ROW_NUMBER() and LAG() to rank stocks by their price volatility (standard deviation of daily returns) within each sector. Return: stock_code, sector, current_price, moving_avg_20day, momentum_pct, volatility_rank. Filter for stocks with volume > 1M shares and order by momentum descending.

daily_quests.title: NSW Road Crash Data Cleaning & Severity Classification
daily_quests.description: Download the NSW Road Crash Data (CSV format). Clean the dataset by: (1) handling missing values in injury_type and crash_type columns (document imputation strategy), (2) standardising date formats to YYYY-MM-DD, (3) removing duplicate records based on crash_id, (4) creating a new severity_score column (0-10 scale) based on number_of_casualties and speed_zone, (5) exporting cleaned data to a new CSV. Provide a data quality report showing before/after row counts, missing value percentages, and outliers detected in casualty counts.

daily_quests.title: Australian Wine Production ETL Pipeline
daily_quests.description: Build a Python script that: (1) extracts wine production data by region and varietal from the Australian Wine Production Statistics dataset, (2) cleans region names (standardise case, remove extra whitespace), (3) filters for top 10 producing regions, (4) loads the cleaned data into a local SQLite database with proper schema (region, varietal, production_volume_tonnes, year), (5) executes a SQL query to calculate year-over-year growth % for each region, ranked by growth rate. Output: a CSV file containing region, varietal, production_volume_tonnes, year, and yoy_growth_pct, sorted by highest growth.
